en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4668 - It was narrated from Ayyub ibn Nuh who said:
Ali ibn Shu'ayb wrote to Abu al-Hasan (as) asking: "A woman breastfed one of my children. Is it permissible for me to marry one of her children?"
Imam (as) wrote in response, "That is not permissible because her children have become like your own children."
